$comment: Every DOM dependency of the Meet adapter (docs/adr/0004). Strategies are tried in order; regexes are case-insensitive and every locale is tried. A key is verified only when it was confirmed in a real call; verifiedIn lists the Meet languages it was confirmed in. jsname/jscontroller values come from the owner's inspection and the calibration runner in a real pt-BR call on 2026-11-03 (docs/meet-adapter/reports/); Google can rename them, so each key keeps a label-based fallback. Unverified strategies are educated guesses. See docs/meet-adapter/calibration.md.

leaveButton.$comment: For the meeting's host, Meet asks before leaving: "Sair da chamada" or "Encerrar a chamada para todos".

handButton.$comment: Meet exposes the hand's state only in the label: "Levantar a mão" while it is down, "Abaixar a mão" while it is up (no aria-pressed).

activeSpeaker.$comment: UNVERIFIED, from one sample: when the iPhone spoke, two [jsname='QgSmzd'] elements in its tile gained the class wEsLMd (and lost gjg47c). Obfuscated classes change with Meet releases; needs more samples (alternate speakers). data-speaking, data-self-name and data-participant-name do not exist. The name is probably the tile's span.notranslate.

participantCount.$comment: The top bar's People button, found through its hidden "Pessoas" label (aria-labelledby); the number is in .fs3avc inside it. Confirmed with 2 participants. span[data-avatar-count] also read 2; it may count only the avatars shown, so it is not used until compared with 4+ people.

mutedSpeakingNotice.$comment: UNVERIFIED: not detected in the pt-BR session. The exact pt-BR notice text, and whether it appeared, are still to be confirmed.

meetingTitle.$comment: Found in a real call. In an instant meeting it shows the meeting code, which the adapter drops; a calendar event's title is not confirmed yet.
